title: TRICARE Select Coverage and the First Month Counted in a TRICARE Prime Proration Credit
content:
When a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment ends for a credit-eligible reason, TRICARE Select coverage of the same beneficiary decides the month with which counting starts on the credited installment.

TRICARE Select coverage is read from the beneficiary's TRICARE Select enrollment, from the month containing its effective date through the month containing its disenrollment date, or every month from its effective month on where it has no disenrollment date.

| TRICARE Select coverage | Counting starts with |
|---|---|
| reaches every month of the credited installment | the installment's first month |
| reaches the month containing the Prime disenrollment date | that month |
| otherwise | the month after the month containing the disenrollment date |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; Prime installment covering January to December, Prime disenrollment date 20 July)

| TRICARE Select enrollment | Months its coverage reaches | Counting starts with |
|---|---|---|
| effective 1 January last year, disenrolled 31 December this year | every month of the installment | January |
| effective 21 July, disenrolled 30 November | July to November | July |
| effective 1 September, disenrolled 31 December | September to December | August |
| effective 21 July, no disenrollment date | July onward | July |
| none | none | August |
